meta.disclaimer: SYNTHETIC, SAP-STYLE (simplified) data generated by Lekha. Not real SAP data, no SAP connection.

data_quality.note: Defects are injected at ~2% per table; quarantine % is higher because rows whose parent was rejected are rejected too (ORPHAN_KEY cascade).

regression.target: days_to_pay = payment date - invoice date (paid invoices only)
regression.note: Test window includes a synthetic regime change (APAC customers pay ~6 days later from 2025-07); models trained on 2023-24 do not know about it, so APAC 2025-07..09 is biased low.

cash_collection.caveat: Only invoices already open at the as-of date; payment behaviour bootstrapped from paid history, so never-paying customers (absent from paid history) make this optimistic.

safety_stock.method: Bootstrap lead times from PO/goods-receipt history; bootstrap daily demand over each simulated lead time. Analytic = z*sqrt(L*sd_d^2 + d^2*sd_L^2) (normal approx.); simulated = empirical percentile of demand during lead time.

nlp.note: Text is template-generated with typos/filler/mixed-signal sentences and 4% label noise, so scores are optimistic compared with real free-text disputes.
